reuse.why: Patches the same inline worst-case expression in api-models.ts, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and forecast-schedules.ts instead of moving the rule into one shared helper (e.g. alongside getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts) that all three call.

duplication.why: The new rule (`x - getApproxNumberThreshold(x)` for approximate, `Math.min(num1, num2)` for ranges) is written three times in parallel edits.

placement.why: The rule stays scattered across an API model, a shared preview function and the forecast module rather than living in shared/schedules.ts where the amount helper is.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the amount rule and its tests, though forecast ranges also switch from midpoint to the new rule as part of the same change.

maintainability.why: Three hand-synchronised copies of a nested ternary must all be changed together the next time the rule moves, which is exactly the gap this request exposed.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared worst-case helper exists in the tree; the sites were already inline and the diff keeps them so rather than going around an abstraction.

disguised_duplication.where: The three copies in server/api-models.ts, shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and server/forecast/forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule are near-verbatim and recognisable, not disguised.
